stem: Which seizure description is most suggestive of a focal structural brain lesion?

options.text: A brief generalised tonic-clonic seizure during fever
A focal tonic-clonic seizure beginning in one arm
A typical absence seizure with brief staring
A myoclonic jerk just after falling asleep
A benign shuddering episode in infancy

explanation: A seizure that begins focally in one limb suggests a focal onset and raises concern for a structural brain lesion or other focal pathology, particularly when afebrile or recurrent.
